intro: One medium banana has about 100 kcal. Almost all of it comes from carbs, which means natural sugar and starch.
diet: Yes, bananas are great when you're trying to lose weight. They're light, easy to carry and give you energy, for example before a workout. No single food makes you fat on its own, and bananas are no different. Just count it as a snack, and go easy on the fried version.
tips: Make a banana your tea-time snack instead of kuih or biscuits.
Pair it with a boiled egg or yogurt for extra protein so you stay full longer.
Choose fresh bananas over pisang goreng. Save the fried ones for once in a while.

swap.name: 1 pisang emas
swap.why: Smaller size, still sweet. Good if you just want to settle a sweet craving.

faq.q: Is it better to eat a banana before or after exercise?
faq.a: Both are okay. Before exercise, it gives quick energy. After exercise, pair it with protein like eggs or milk.
Yes. As a banana ripens, the starch turns into sugar, so it tastes sweeter. The calories stay about the same.

faq.q: Can people with diabetes eat bananas?
faq.a: Many can, in small portions, but everyone is different. Best to follow your doctor or dietitian's advice.
